title: Kaar – Sensor Overview
description: Live demo: Bäckerei Demo GmbH. Simulated freezer + cold room; a freezer door incident is replayed every 6 hours.

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM tenant_devices ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, device AS metric, avg(value) AS value
FROM tenant_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND metric = 'temperature' AND device_id IN ($device)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT started_at AS "since", severity, device, kind, peak_value AS peak
FROM tenant_alert_events WHERE resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC

SELECT started_at, resolved_at, round(extract(epoch FROM resolved_at - started_at) / 60) AS minutes,
  device, kind, severity, peak_value AS peak
FROM tenant_alert_events WHERE started_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT d.site, d.name AS device, d.last_seen,
  (SELECT value FROM tenant_readings r WHERE r.device_id = d.id AND r.metric = 'battery'
   AND r.time > now() - interval '1 day' ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery
FROM tenant_devices d ORDER BY d.site, d.name
